title: You Owe Me Nought
style: Bedroom pop with fingerpicked acoustic guitar, brushed percussion and detuned synth bass; hushed, androgynous low-register vocal; 92 BPM with a stripped verse building into a dropped chorus release; intimate bathroom-room tone and small-room vocal bleed.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You grumble soft that life with me
weighs heavy on your chest each night,
yet still you nod and take my hand
and follow where I lead the light.

[Pre-Chorus]
You're not trapped
in the scheme of things;
you still have your wings.

[Chorus]
Feel free to leave—
you owe me nought.
Feel free to choose
your path, your thought.

[Verse 2]
You mutter low of chains that bind
and how the years have worn you thin,
yet every time the choice arrives
you keep complying, and give in.

[Pre-Chorus]
Nobody's keeping you
against your will;
you don't owe me a bill.

[Chorus]
Feel free to leave—
you owe me nought.
Feel free to choose
your path, your thought.

[Break]
You grumble that the days with me
feel long.
You claim the weight has worn you thin
and wrong.
You mutter how you long to leave
this place.
Yet still you nod and keep the pace
I trace.

[Final Chorus]
Feel free to leave—
you owe me nought.
Feel free to choose
your path, your thought.
Feel free to be
instead of to rot.
